blurb: Guests join Captain Zach Castro aboard the 35' Carolina Classic Knot Tuggin to fish inshore, nearshore, and offshore waters targeting pelagic and bottom species. Trips include half day and full day inshore fishing, offshore fishing, whale watching, and sunset cruises for up to 6 guests. Guests bring their own food, drinks, sunglasses, and sunscreen (no spray sunscreen).
